description: Source code for a wizard in Odoo (OpenERP) that creates invoices from stock pickings, including form definitions, logic for determining invoice type, and invoice creation process.

classes.name: make_invoice_onshipping
classes.description: Wizard interface class for creating invoices from stock shipping pickings.

methods.name: _get_type
methods.description: Determines the invoice type based on the stock picking's move lines and usage.

methods.name: _create_invoice
methods.description: Creates an invoice for the selected stock picking and returns the action window to display it.
